messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@marketly.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Sep 2024 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Self signup — looking for a short demo for embeddings + chat

Hi Karthik,

I signed up last week (trial) and have been poking around the API. We’re evaluating Redwood to power two new features in our product:

- Vector search for product recommendations (embeddings) — want nightly batch indexing and realtime kNN for 2M product vectors.
- A lightweight chat assistant for support triage — expect ~1,500 chats/day at pilot, ~40k/day at scale.

Timeline: pilot in ~3 weeks (small cohort), production in 3–4 months. Major questions: latency expectations for the chat path, cost guidance for mixed embeddings + chat workload, and how SSO / SAML would fit into a pilot.

I attached a small CSV with a sample traffic slice (marketly-sample-traffic.csv). Can someone take a quick look and propose a 30-minute slot this week to walk through architecture and narrow scope?

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform
Marketly
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@marketly.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Sep 2024 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Self signup — looking for a short demo for embeddings + chat

Sam — thanks for the note and the sample CSV, that’s super helpful. Short answers up front and then a couple of clarifying Qs so we can make the demo high-value:

Quick summary:
- We can support both nightly batch embedding jobs and realtime kNN; we usually recommend embeddings-first for retrieval, then add an LLM chat layer for context.
- For chat at 1.5k/day pilot (~40k/day at scale) we’ll want to confirm average prompt length (tokens) and concurrency targets to size dedicated capacity vs hosted.
- SSO/SAML for Private/Dedicated is straightforward; for hosted trials we can provide a scoped service account and step-up SSO during pilot if needed.

Clarifying questions (quick bullet answers will do):
1) Average tokens per chat request (prompt + expected completion).
2) Typical QPS during peak minute for the chat path.
3) Are the embeddings indexing jobs latency-sensitive (nearline / realtime)?
4) Any compliance constraints (data residency/SOC2 required for pilot)?

Proposed next steps:
- If you’re flexible, pick a 30-min slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-demo-30m — I’ve cc’d Avery (SDR) to help coordinate and Laura (SE) will join if we lock in technical sizing.
- I’ve attached our quick trial checklist (redwood-trial-checklist.pdf) — it outlines what we’ll need before a production pilot (sample queries, SSO contact, expected ramp).

If you prefer, I can propose three slots — morning PST or late afternoon works best on our side.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — answers below inline and I added Priya (sec/compliance) for residency questions.

On Tue, Sep 3, 2024 at 10:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Average tokens per chat request (prompt + expected completion).
We’re seeing ~120 tokens prompt and expect ~180 tokens completion in pilot. Full production might average 200/250.

> 2) Typical QPS during peak minute for the chat path.
Peak conversational QPS for pilot: ~4–6 QPS. Production estimate: ~60–80 QPS peak minute.

> 3) Are the embeddings indexing jobs latency-sensitive (nearline / realtime)?
Indexing is nightly batch today; realtime indexing won’t be required for pilot.

> 4) Any compliance constraints (data residency/SOC2 required for pilot)?
We need SOC2 evidence and logging for audit; data residency is US-only for now. Priya will review specifics.

Availability: we’re available Thursday 9/5 between 10:00–12:00 PDT or Friday 9/6 after 13:00 PDT. If you can’t do those times, suggest alternatives.

Attached: marketly-sample-traffic.csv (already sent)

— Sam
